system.concept: Anarch Sleeper Spy Posing as a Camarilla Malkavian
system.biography:
Roleplaying Hints

You are a member of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} in good standing, believed to be the prodigal childe of a particularly insightful sire who was an advisor to the past prince. As such, you have status, prestige within your clan and two very big—and very dangerous—secrets. First, you are not really a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian}, but merely passing as one; the real childe of the previous seer was a friend of yours among the anarchs who met Final Death at the hands of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} almost a decade ago. Since her sire disappeared mysteriously a few years back, though, it's unlikely anyone will be able to call your bluff. Besides, the court was happy enough to have its previous advisor's favored childe return from hiatus to fill the void, and you are more than happy to oblige them. Second, you are not a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} Kindred, you are an anarch, and have been since your Embrace almost three decades ago. You relish letting the arrogant Camarilla stooges believe they are pulling your strings, and pretend not to hear when they snicker at the suffering of the “poor Lunatic.” You've made yourself useful with a combination of pseudo-mystical pronouncements and cleverly couched information fed to the prince in the guise of “prophecies” that your fellow revolutionaries are only too happy to help ensure come to pass just often enough to keep the court listening to you. Your true value to the Movement has yet to come to light, however. For the time being you are a sleeper, quietly building the court's trust in you while waiting for a particularly inspired opportunity to buck the system and do some real damage before skipping town again.

Stat Block (as printed)

Clan: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.SNuXttNqxzJ6uPXv]{Caitiff} (posing as @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian})
Nature: Rebel
Demeanor: Dabbler
Generation: 10th

Physical (8): Quick x2, Tough x2, Agile, Graceful x2, Robust, Delicate (N)
Social (10): Seductive, Witty, Callous (N), Eloquent, Gorgeous x2, Charming, Commanding x2, Ingratiating
Mental (12): Ambitious, Creative x3, Disciplined x2, Insightful, Knowledgeable x2, Reflective x2, Shrewd

Abilities: Athletics, Expert Ability: Counterfeiting x4, Dodge x2, Melee x2, Performance (Acting) x2, Subterfuge x3, Occult, Politics x2, Intimidation

Disciplines: Dominate (Command, Mesmerism, Forgetful Mind); Obfuscate (Cloak of Shadows, Unseen Presence, Mask of a Thousand Faces); Presence (Awe, Dread Gaze)

Backgrounds: Allies x3, Resources x3, Herd, Influence: Bureaucracy x3, Influence: Church x2, Influence: High Society, Influence: Street x2, Influence: Law x2
Merits: Daredevil, Personal Masquerade (Malkavian)
Flaws: Dark Secret (Anarch spy)
Virtues: Conscience 3, Self-Control 4, Courage 3
Path: Humanity 3
Reputation: Camarilla: Acknowledged, Cultured, Respected. Anarch: Committed, Bond (Girl)
Blood: 13 (may spend 1/round)
Willpower: 4

system.description: By meeting your subject's gaze and speaking a single emphasized word of command, you win a Mental Challenge to force immediate, unquestioning obedience to a simple order lasting no more than ten minutes.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: By meeting your subject's gaze and winning a Mental Challenge, you implant a more complex command, optionally tied to a specific trigger event, to be carried out immediately or later.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: By winning a Mental Challenge while holding your victim's gaze, you can erase, alter, or implant up to fifteen minutes of memory per challenge, or question the subject to recall details they otherwise might not share.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: By remaining completely still and silent in shadow or behind cover, you fade from notice to all but those using Auspex or similar senses; any movement, speech, or interaction breaks the concealment immediately.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: Once hidden from sight, you may move about at a walk and remain unnoticed, automatically becoming visible only if you speak, make loud noise, or interact with your surroundings.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

items.name: Obfuscate — 2 Intermediate — Mask of a Thousand Faces

system.description: Your features appear bland and unremarkable to onlookers, or by spending a Mental Trait you can assume a specific guise, copying another's appearance up to the Social Traits you can afford to match, lasting until you sleep, are knocked out, or die.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: By spending a Social Trait during a Social Challenge, you gain an automatic retest, usable once per challenge (or once per target in a mass challenge at the same cost).
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: By hissing and baring your vampiric features in a Social Challenge, you strike terror into a victim who, if defeated, flees and avoids you for the rest of the scene or hour, risking an extra Trait to act against you if cornered.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
